message.content:
Based on the visual inspection of the time series plot, the data exhibits a significant and sustained drop in value (from around -10 mm to -40 mm) towards the end of the series. This behavior deviates strongly from the fluctuations observed in the rest of the chart.

The anomaly appears to start around index 650 and continues until the end of the plotted data at approximately index 730.

[[650, 730]]
